title: 'Now That We Draw' Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast, Ending Song Artist, January 8 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kyū Takahata and Yūji Kaba 's Now That We Draw ( Kakunaru Ue wa ) manga unveiled on Wednesday the anime's main promotional video, main visual, new cast member, and January 8 premiere. The anime's staff also announced the ending theme song "Serifu wa Iranai" (We Don't Need Dialogues) by the rock band Inner Journey . The video previews the opening theme song "Kimiiro Hikari" (The Light of Your Color) by the band shallm .

Hina Yomiya joins the cast as Ren Shioiri, a talented manga artist with a weekly series:

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX and BS11 channels on January 8 at 24:30 JST (effectively January 9 at 12:30 a.m.). The anime will run on AT-X on January 11 at 10:00 p.m. JST.

Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Dweeby high schooler Yūki Uehara has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she's bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara's dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Niina Miyamoto—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara's concocted, and he certainly isn't the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?

Ayumu Murase and Sayumi Suzushiro will star as Yūki Uehara and Niina Miyamoto, respectively.

Shunsuke Ishikawa ( BLUE LOCK THE MOVIE -EPISODE NAGI- ) is directing the anime at ROLL2 , and Deko Akao ( Arakawa Under the Bridge , Komi Can't Communicate ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Hiromi Nakagawa ( WATATEN!: an Angel Flew Down to Me , Saint Cecilia and Pastor Lawrence ) is designing the characters, and Infinite is producing.

The additional staff includes:

• Sub-Character Design: Momoka Izumi

• Color Key Artist: Yurie Matsuura

• Art Director: Arei Saiga

• Compositing Director of Photography: Hayato Kifune (EOTA)

• 3D CG: Masashi Watanabe

• Editing: Mai Hasegawa

• Sound Director: Fumiyuki Go

• Sound Effects: Ryūta Nakahara

• Music: Yoshiaki Miura

• Produce: Infinite

The manga launched in Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine in 2023, and Hakusensha published the eighth compiled book volume on September 29. Seven Seas Entertainment will publish the sixth volume in English on December 29.

title: Manga '25-ji, Akasaka de' Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
An official website opened for a television anime adaptation of Hiroko Natsuno 's 25-ji, Akasaka de ( At 25:00 in Akasaka ) web manga on Wednesday, revealing the main cast, teaser visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video. The anime will premiere on TBS in 2027.

Voice actors Souma Saitou ( Odayaka Kizoku no Kyuuka no Susume. ) and Takuya Satou ( Super no Ura de Yani Suu Futari ) are starring in the anime as Yuki Shirasaki and Asami Hayama, respectively.

Natsuno began serializing the boys' love manga in onBLUE in November 2017. The series moved to the main onBLUE magazine in April 2018, where it remains ongoing. Shodensha published the fifth volume in June 2024. 25-ji, Akasaka de has surpassed 2 million copies in cumulative circulation, including digital editions.

The manga was digitally published in English as At 25:00, in Akasaka by Fantasista Inc. Seven Seas Entertainment licensed the series for English print publication in March 2024, releasing the fifth volume in November 2025.

An audio drama adaptation produced by Fifth Avenue was released on CD. The first CD, adapting the first volume, went on sale in December 2020. The fifth and latest CD, adapting the fifth volume, was released in April 2025.

A live-action television drama adaptation produced by TV Tokyo and GagaOOLala aired for 10 episodes from April to June 2024. A second season aired from October to December 2025.

25-ji, Akasaka de won the Best Series category at the 2023 Chil Chil BL Awards . Its second audio drama CD also won the Best BLCD category at the same awards.

Synopsis Yuki Shirasaki finally landed his big break. But the pressure is on when he’s cast alongside current superstar (and his former classmate!) Asami Hayama. Determined to do his best, he decides to dive deep into researching playing the role of a gay man and visits a gay bar for a one-night stand. To his surprise, Hayama is there and gives Shirasaki the shock of his life by suggesting they become friends with benefits! Can Shirasaki keep his attention on the role, or will he be captivated by Hayama’s good looks and irresistible charm? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Teaser PV

title: Migratory Birds & Snail TV Anime Debuts Next Summer
content:
The wraparound jacket band on Makoto Takatsu 's seventh compiled Wataridori to Katatsumuri ( Migratory birds & Snail ) manga volume announced that the television anime of the manga will premiere in summer 2027. The manga's latest volume shipped on Wednesday.

The manga tells the story of Unpei Mochizuki, a young man in his second year working at a machine parts distributor. After causing trouble to a customer because of a mistake he made, Unpei suddenly thought about going somewhere far away, where no on knows him. He stops his car on the side of the road, where he meets Tsugumi Nagisa, a picture book writer who travels in her car with her dog. Together, they start a free-spirited journey, going around Japan, traveling and sleeping in the car.

The manga's anime adaptation was first announced in 2024.

Takatsu launched the manga on Wani Books ' web manga magazine NewsCrunch in October 2019. Wani Books published the manga's first volume in August 2020, and the third volume in September 2021. The manga went on hiatus since the release of the third volume, and resumed serialization in 2024.

title: 'Youchien Wars' Unveils Staff, Main Promo, Opening Theme
content:
The official website for the Youchien Wars ( Kindergarten Wars ) revealed additional staff, opening theme, main visual (pictured), and main promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series adapting You Chiba 's action comedy manga will air on TV Tokyo network stations in April 2027.

Staff Series Composition, Script: Takaomi Kanasaki ( Silent Witch ) Art Director: Satoru Kuwahara ( Isekai Yururi Kikou ) Color Design: Saori Yoshida ( Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo! ) CG Director: Masami Suzuki Director of Photography: Naoki Etou ( Cool Doji Danshi ) Editing: Kashiko Kimura ( Awajima Hyakkei ) Sound Director: Ryou Tanaka ( Egao no Taenai Shokuba desu. ) Music: Hiroshi Nakamura ( Lv999 no Murabito ), Kenta Higashiooji ( Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu ), Dai Haraguchi ( Ugoku! Neko Mukashibanashi )

Japanese singer Ado ( Cat's♥Eye ) is performing the opening theme "Viva Yattara Metta," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Shinsuke Gomi ( Silent Witch episode director) is helming the anime at Sunrise and Felix Film . Junko Yamanaka ( Servamp ) is designing the characters.

Chiba began serializing the manga on the Shounen Jump+ web magazine in September 2022. Shueisha published the 18th volume on August 4, with the 19th volume planned for a December 4 release.

Yen Press licensed the manga in English in October 2024 and released the fifth volume on October 27, with the sixth volume going on sale in March 2027. Shueisha's Manga Plus platform also simulpublishes it in English, Spanish, Thai, and French.

Main PV

title: Kindergarten Wars Anime's Video Reveals More Staff, ado's Opening Song, April Debut
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks unveiled the first full promotional video and main visual for the television anime of Yū Chiba 's Kindergarten WARS ( Yōchien Wars ) manga on Wednesday. The video announces more staff members and the April premiere for the anime, and also announces and previews the anime's opening theme song "Bibayatarametta" by singer Ado .

As previously announced, Shinsuke Gomi (episode director for Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba , Secrets of the Silent Witch ) is directing the anime at Sunrise and Felix Film , and Junko Yamanaka ( Kamisama Kiss , Servamp ) is designing the characters.

Takaomi Kanasaki ( KONOSUBA director, Princess Connect! Re:Dive director and writer, Secrets of the Silent Witch chief director and writer) joins the staff, and is writing and supervising the series' scripts. Satoru Kuwabara is the art director, while Saori Yoshiida is credited for color setting. Masaomi Suzuki is the CG director. Naoki Etō is the compositing director of photography, while Kashiko Kimura is the editor. Ryoshi Tanaka is the sound director. Hiroshi Nakamura , Kenta Higashiohji , and Dai Haraguchi are composing the music.

Yen Press is publishing the manga in print and it describes the story:

Rita is Convict 999, a former legendary assassin who now works at a kindergarten for the children of world leaders. Her job is to protect the schoolchildren from the clutches of would-be assassins sent after them! But even with her overwhelming strength, Rita has a weakness—she's head-over-heels for good-looking men!

The anime stars:

• Atsumi Tanezaki as Rita

• Kentarō Kumagai as Doug

• Hitomi Ohwada as Hana

• Satoshi Hino as Luke

• Mariya Ise as Silvia

• Romi Park as Erina

• Tetsu Inada as Gordon

• Mirei Kumagai as Mac

• Sumire Morohoshi as Una

Shueisha 's MANGA Plus website publishes the Kindergarten WARS manga digitally.

Chiba launched the manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ app and website in September 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 18th compiled book volume on August 4. The manga entered its final arc in March 2025, and has over 2 million copies in circulation.

Chiba launched the Yōchien Wars -LUKE- ( Kindergarten WARS -LUKE- ) spinoff manga in November 2024. The spinoff manga is a 180-page story about the character Luke.

title: 'Himekishi-sama no Himo' Reveals Supporting Cast, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the Himekishi-sama no Himo ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ) television anime adaptation revealed supporting cast and second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime adapting Tooru Shirogane 's action fantasy light novel will premiere on AT-X on January 3 at 11.30 p.m., followed by broadcasts on Tokyo MX and BS Asahi.

Cast Ralph: Yuuya Hirose ( World Is Dancing ) Noelle: Manaka Iwami ( Oni no Hanayome ) Beatrice Maretto: Shion Wakayama ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria ) Cecilia Maretto: Saori Oonishi ( Yomi no Tsugai )

Japanese rock group sajou no hana ( Himekishi wa Barbaroi no Yome ) is performing the ending theme "Gika," which is previewed in the promotional video below.

Chihiro Kumano ( Unnamed Memory assistant director) is helming the anime at Blade , with Deko Akao ( Ragna Crimson ) handling the series composition. Hisao Ishii ( Ushinawareta Mirai wo Motomete design assistant) is designing the characters. Taku Iwasaki is composing the music.

Shirogane began penning the action fantasy story under the Dengeki Bunko imprint in February 2022, with illustrations by Saki Mashima . Kadokawa published the seventh volume on July 10.

A manga adaptation drawn by Key Yang began in September 2022. The third and final volume was released in December 2024.

Chihiro Yamazaki launched a sequel of the manga titled Himekishi-sama no Himo Act 2 on the same website in August 2025. Kadokawa released the first volume on January 27.

Yen Press licensed both the light novel and manga adaptation in 2023. The sixth light novel volume was released on August 11. The third manga volume went on sale on January 6.

PV 2

title: The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast, Ending Song, January 3 Debut
content:
Kadokawa revealed a new promotional video, additional cast members, and January 3 premiere for the television anime of Toru Shirogame's The Kept Man of the Princess Knight ( Himekishi-sama no Himo ) light novel series on Wednesday. The video previews the ending theme song "Gika" (Pseudanthium) by the rock band sajou no hana .

The newly announced cast members are:

Yūya Hirose as Ralph, a young warrior of the adventurer party Aegis led by Arwin

Manaka Iwami as Noel, a newcomer in the Aegis party

Shion Wakayama as Beatrice, the mage and leader of the adventurer party Medusa and the younger of the Mallet sisters

Saori Ōnishi as Cecilia, mage of the Medusa party and Beatrice's older sister

The Dungeon City is a wicked place filled with crime, debauchery, and death. Its one shining light is Arwin, the beautiful Crimson Princess Knight. She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city's center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess's fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of.

The anime stars:

• Junichi Suwabe as Matthew

• Mikako Komatsu as Arwin

• Rie Takahashi as Vanessa

• Tetsu Inada as Dezu

• Rika Nagae as April

Chihiro Kumano ( Eiga Odekake Kozame Tokai no Otomodachi , A Couple of Cuckoos ) is directing the series at BLADE . Hisao Ishii ( There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless... , In Search of the Lost Future ) is designing the characters based on the original light novel designs by Saki Mashima . Deko Akao ( After the Rain , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) is in charge of series scripts.

Other staff members include:

• Action Director: Hibiki Yamaguchi

• Prop Design/Monster Design: Recommendation, Inc.

• Art Setting: Shingo Kakimoto (Quun Plant)

• Art Director: Ryōsuke Kawai (Quun Plant)

• Color Design: Naomi Nakano (Stella)

• Assistant Color Design: Yuki Kadomatsu (Stella)

• 3D Director: Yoshinori Ban

• 2D Works: Yumeta Company

• Compositing Director of Photography: Kōdai Washizu

• Offline Editing: Nobutaka Maki (TAVAC), Kiminori Yoshida (TAVAC)

• Music: Taku Iwasaki

• Sound Director: Satoshi Motoyama

• Casting Manager: Ippei Tomari

• Sound Producer: INSPION Edge

The anime will premiere on the AT-X channel on January 3 at 11:30 p.m. JST (9:30 a.m. EST). The anime will then run on Tokyo MX at 24:30 JST, and on BS Asahi at 25:30 JST (effectively January 4 at 12:30 a.m. and 1:30 a.m., respectively).

Shirogane's light novel series reached over 200,000 copies in circulation and won the 28th annual Dengeki Novel Awards grand prize. Kadokawa will ship the eighth novel volume on January 8. Yen Press shipped the sixth volume on August 11.

Keyyang launched a manga adaptation of the light novel series. Kadokawa shipped the third and final compiled book volume in December 2024. Yen Press publishes the manga in English and shipped the third compiled book volume on January 6.

Chihiro Yamazaki launched a new manga series based on the novels titled Himekishi-sama no Himo Act 2 ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Act 2) on Kadokawa 's KadoComi website in August 2025. Kadokawa published the manga's first volume on January 27, and will publish the second volume on December 24.

The video previews the ending theme song "Gika" (Pseudanthium) by the rock band sajou no hana .

Yūya Hirose as Ralph, a young warrior of the adventurer party Aegis led by Arwin

Manaka Iwami as Noel, a newcomer in the Aegis party

Shion Wakayama as Beatrice, the mage and leader of the adventurer party Medusa and the younger of the Mallet sisters

Saori Ōnishi as Cecilia, mage of the Medusa party and Beatrice's older sister

She and her brave party of adventurers descend into the dungeon at the city's center, seeking a legendary treasure with the power to rebuild the princess's fallen kingdom. Many yearn to be by her side, but that spot is already taken by Matthew, a man despised by all in town as a cowardly weakling. Everyone thinks he is scum who just spends her hard-earned money on booze, women, and gambling. No one in the city—not even the princess knight— knows what Matthew is truly capable of.

The anime stars:

• Junichi Suwabe as Matthew

• Mikako Komatsu as Arwin

• Rie Takahashi as Vanessa

• Tetsu Inada as Dezu

• Rika Nagae as April

Chihiro Kumano ( Eiga Odekake Kozame Tokai no Otomodachi , A Couple of Cuckoos ) is directing the series at BLADE . Hisao Ishii ( There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless... , In Search of the Lost Future ) is designing the characters based on the original light novel designs by Saki Mashima . Deko Akao ( After the Rain , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) is in charge of series scripts.

Chihiro Yamazaki launched a new manga series based on the novels titled Himekishi-sama no Himo Act 2 ( The Kept Man of the Princess Knight Act 2) on Kadokawa 's KadoComi website in August 2025. Kadokawa published the manga's first volume on January 27, and will publish the second volume on December 24.

title: Supporting Cast for 'Cheat Fuyo' Announced
content:
The official X account of the Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu? ( The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a New Life: I Can Add "Enhancement Points" Not Just to Weapons but to Anything, and I Can Cancel the Effects Whenever I Want, but Are the People Left Behind Going to Be Okay? ) television anime announced additional cast members Wednesday. The anime series adapting Asa Rokushima and Youmochi Gyoumu 's adventure fantasy manga began airing on October 7 at 12:00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by AT-X.

Cast Mirasuke: Natsumi Kawaida ( Futsutsuka na Akujo dewa Gozaimasu ga ) Mirakichi: Ruriko Noguchi ( Itai no wa Iya nanode Bougyoryoku ni Kyokufuri Shitai to Omoimasu. ) Miratarou: Nene Hieda ( Summer Pockets ) Mirazou: Misato Matsuoka ( Yani Neko ) Mirajirou: Sayaka Kikuchi ( Fantasy Bishoujo Juniku Ojisan to ) Miranori: Hana Hishikawa ( Sayonara Lara )

Shuu Honma ( Mayonaka Punch ) is directing the anime at P.A. Works , with Youko Yonaiyama ( Yubisaki to Renren ) handling the series composition. Yuito Kiyosawa ( Mikadono Sanshimai wa Angai, Choroi. sub-character design) is designing the characters. Alisa Okehazama ( Jujutsu Kaisen ) is composing the music.

Rokushima began penning the adventure fantasy story on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in January 2021. Youmochi Gyoumu began serializing the manga in Shounen Magazine R in October that year and transferred it to Getsumaga Kichi web manga portal in March 2023 following the former's discontinuation. Kodansha published the 22th volume on October 8.

Kodansha began publishing the light novel adaptation under its K Ranobe Book label with illustrations by kisui in January 2022. The second volume went on sale in October 2022.

Kodansha began simulpublishing the manga in English on its K Manga service as The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life on March 19.

title: 'Historie' Unveils Production Staff, Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Second Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hitoshi Iwaaki 's Historie manga revealed the production staff, additional cast, theme songs, key visual (pictured), and a second promotional video on Wednesday. The anime is scheduled to premiere as a two-episode special on January 9 at 1:23 a.m. on MBS, TBS, CBC, and Prime Video, followed by BS-TBS and AT-X.

Cast Antigonus: Fumihiko Tachiki ( Bleach ) Satura: Akira Sekine ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar ) Bato: Toshiki Masuda ( Boku no Hero Academia ) Dimakos: Ryouta Takeuchi ( Mahoutsukai no Yome ) Telemakos: Seiichirou Yamashita ( 86 ) Narrator: Mirai Moriyama ( Saint☆Oniisan )

Staff Director: Nobuharu Kamanaka ( Toaru Kagaku no Accelerator ) Assistant Director: Takaaki Suzuki ( Toujima Tanzaburou wa Kamen Rider ni Naritai ) Character Design, Chief Animation Director: Isoroku Koga ( Mattaku Saikin no Tantei to Kitara ) Series Composition, Script: Toshiya Oono ( 86 ) Prop Design: Kenichi Ootomo ( Bungou Stray Dogs key animation) Art Director: Minami Kasuga ( Beastars ) Art Design: Eiko Tsunadou ( Hikaru ga Shinda Natsu ) Color Design: Aiko Yamagami ( Isekai de Cheat Skill wo Te ni Shita Ore wa, Genjitsu Sekai wo mo Musou Suru ) 2D Design: Misato Kuramochi (Asahi Production) ( Kingdom 5th Season ) Director of Photography: Naho Hasegawa (Asahi Production) ( Zom 100 ) 3DCG: SANZIGEN Editing: Mai Hasegawa (Editz) ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai ) Music: Gin Hashiba ( Tensei Kenja no Isekai Life ) Sound Director: Noriyoshi Konuma ( Tenmaku no Jaadugar ) Sound Production: Bit grooove promotion Historical Research: Shishin Fujimura Studio: LIDENFILMS

• Yorushika ( Sousou no Frieren ) is performing the opening theme "Masshiro" and Retroriron ( Higeki no Genkyou to Naru Saikyou Gedou Last Boss Joou wa Tami no Tame ni Tsukushimasu. Season 2 ) performs the ending theme "Amphilia." The opening theme is previewed in the promotional video below.

Iwaaki began serializing the historical adventure manga in Afternoon magazine in January 2003. Kodansha published the 12th volume in June 2024.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English for an omnibus physical release in July 2026, with the first two volumes planned to be released on April 27, 2027. The manga is published digitally by Kodansha through the K Manga website.
